description:
AI-native developer terminal built on Tauri and Rust

Gear is a fast, lightweight developer terminal built on Tauri and Rust. It combines a native PTY backend with an integrated AI assistant, code editor, file explorer, and source control panel.
0.1.4 (2026-08-23)
Features
- complete broadcast input to all panes in a tab (a4abd4d)
- editor: line operations for sorting, dedupe and cleanup (573ab2f)
- git: amend the last commit from the source control panel (f0cd6e8)
- git: blame gutter in the editor (dc57f6a)
- search: match case, whole word, regex and a result counter (4f1cf79)
- terminal: gate OSC 52 clipboard writes from command output (1e1cef9)
- terminal: sanitize and confirm risky pastes (4aa2b87)
Bug Fixes
- open from explorer (73d019f)
- release: bump Cargo.lock inside the release PR, not after the tag (a447af3)
- release: keep Cargo.lock in step with the release version (4fcbf48)
- winget: sync the winget-pkgs fork before every submission (0c67987)
